title: From three one-off fixes to a reusable tenant-isolation kit
scenario: Three engagements, three one-off tenant-isolation fixes: a Retrieve fallback without the tenant filter, a tool Lambda that read the tenant from its arguments, an embed URL cached at the edge. Fourteen teams in TypeScript and Python, a two-week cadence and a week-long AppSec review. Design the kit that makes the next one structurally hard.
task: Name the common failure pattern behind the three incidents
Design the kit: tenant-context library, CDK construct with ABAC and LeadingKeys, Retrieve wrapper, response and CDN defaults, attack test kit, runbook
Sketch the APIs in TypeScript and Python and a CDK usage example
Plan adoption, evidence that it works, what not to generalize, and the FDE story
acceptance: Graded by rubric (no automated tests; grade.sh reports 0/0)
Each incident mapped to the layer that would have stopped it
Adoption plan fits the constraints; measurable signals that it works

practices.label: Week 7 Fri - FDE: one-off fix to reusable pattern
